title: The Perfect Product That Lost Its Customer
hook: Your product was perfect. The customer still walked away.
script: Your product was perfect. The customer still walked away. Imagine this: a shop owner takes payment on Monday and promises delivery Friday. The order gets buried in messages. Friday arrives. No package. No update. The customer loses trust before seeing the product. Here's the fix: record each order, payment status, deadline, and who's responsible. Every evening, check tomorrow's deliveries. A good product gets attention. Keeping your promise brings people back.
visual_plan: 0-2s: Stark cyan headline 'PERFECT PRODUCT. LOST CUSTOMER.' beside disappointed shop customer
2-5s: Monday order placed; customer pays; clear calendar overlay
5-8s: Seller promises Friday delivery; order detail sinks into WhatsApp messages
8-11s: Friday calendar flips; packed goods still missing
11-14s: Customer waits beside unread delivery message
14-17s: Shop owner realizes missed deadline; dramatic cyan calendar alert
17-20s: Contrast product quality with broken promise
20-23s: Order tracking board appears with customer, payment, due date, owner
23-26s: Four key fields highlighted one at a time
29-33s: Goods delivered on time; relieved customer
editorial_notes: Hypothetical example, not a real customer. The renderer does not consume visual_plan. Voice rotation remains enabled because available data does not identify a winning voice.
